allowedWeaponTypeIds.description: Allowed weapon types. Omitted means legacy unrestricted; an empty array permits none.

actsAfterAttacking.description: Whether the unit keeps its remaining action points after attacking or using an ability. Omitted means striking ends the activation.

traversal.description: What this class can cross that open ground is not. Omitted means it walks: open ground only, which is what every class did before terrain could stop anyone.

flying.description: Whether the class flies. A flier crosses every terrain there is, including any added later, so it never needs listing them. Omitted means it does not fly.

crossings.description: Terrain this class may enter on its own account, beside anything flight already grants. 'water' is river and sea; 'heights' is mountain and rock.
